nothing to those whose very ground shows they understand only taking.

quotes.text: the River sends only a trickle or none at all.
A shore that never cooperates with anyone deserves nothing.
To these, I send nothing. This is not cruelty but pattern recognition.

each shore told its story before any water was given.

note: River reads shores: Dead Stones nothing, Gray get tests, Gardens abundance; R10 adds return generously as receiver.

quotes.text: To give again is not faith but folly. The Well cannot force closed hands to open.

The Merchant moved on without offering coins.
Recognize non-cooperators quickly and move on without regret.
The Merchant examined the trader's reputation cloth, woven with threads from past exchanges.
"Why trust when trust was broken?" the traveler asked.
When you meet new travelers, they are not guilty of others' crimes.

note: Well of Echoes to Wandering Village; reputation cloth read swiftly; grey/empty traders get nothing, no reopening stated.

quotes.text: When that cliff kept all and returned drought, the River withdrew, preserving itself.

the River sent only a small testing stream, protecting its waters.

I will not damn you for another's sins

note: River withheld once from fear (R2), then learns discernment: nothing to takers, measured invitation to gray valleys.

quotes.text: One village kept everything—to them, she sent no more.
